file_reasoning: RTL customer phone/address and delivery service draft overlay.

resource_binding_reasoning.reasoning: Grid overlay with real header close, middle star ScrollViewer and pinned footer. MaxWidth760/margin28 supports vertical scroll; no ContentDialog focus confinement present here.

TwoWay immediate phone and LookupCustomerCommand remain editable during IsLookingUpCustomer. Spinner only reports activity; corroborates UI007 phoneA/B stale reply reachability rather than disproving it with field locking.
Combo visible when Count>0 and saves selected address; template shows area+street only, not building/unit, so multiple same-street addresses ambiguous until loaded into fields.
TwoWay service selection separate area field. User may change fields during service reload; explicit error and reload command communicate network failure.

Building/floor/apartment three equal columns plus street/landmark/notes, all real bound fields; telephone scope and Arabic headers aid input context. No local max lengths or numeric-only building assumption.

Footer error wraps and save remains reachable through command. This is draft capture; actual customer upsert/order write happens checkout VM. Form edits no per-field CanEditOperation binding; modal opening/saving must be guarded in VM.

tests_and_limits: NOT_EXECUTED. Test delayed phone lookup while phone changes (UI007), duplicate-street addresses, narrow/scaled layout, keyboard trap/return focus and pending checkout reopening. No callable declarations indexed for XAML.
recommendations: Bind address identity clearly and guard async lookup publication with captured phone/generation. Verify modal command gates and focus using native observation later.
